objective: Milestone 3: Administrative Review and Opportunity Moderation

tasks.description: Add live user-facing opportunity card and detail preview with policy validation warnings directly inside the admin review workspace (/admin/review)
acceptance_criteria: Live rendered opportunity card and detail view preview in /admin/review matching public visitor view
Interactive validation warnings for conservative date-only policy, funding prerequisites, and source verification
Bilingual labels in English and Simplified Chinese
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/admin-preview.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Extend opportunity lifecycle with explicit archived state, review action archive for closed/rejected records with audited revision history, and admin catalogue filtering
acceptance_criteria: opportunities.state check constraint expanded to include archived
reviewSchema action enum accepts archive for closed or rejected records
reviewOpportunity transitions state to archived and records audit note in opportunity_revisions
Migration 015 with updated staging schema bootstrap and staging test assertion (15 migrations)
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/lifecycle-archive.test.ts tests/staging.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement administrative duplicate opportunity merge service and API endpoint to consolidate duplicate candidate opportunities into a single surviving record, preserving source URL provenance and mapping user saved tracker items without losing progression status
acceptance_criteria: Admin endpoint POST /api/admin/opportunities/[id]/merge requiring admin authentication and CSRF check
Repoints saved_items from duplicate opportunity to surviving target opportunity, preserving highest status progression (applied > applying > interested > dismissed) on collision
Transitions duplicate opportunity state to archived with merge explanation in opportunity_revisions
Records an audited revision on target opportunity linking to the merged duplicate ID
Idempotent and transactionally safe against concurrent saves
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/catalogue-merge.test.ts && npm run typecheck
